description: Short sparks for starting and persevering.

items.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
items.author: Attributed to Nelson Mandela

translations.en: It always seems impossible until it's done.
translations.hi: जब तक काम पूरा न हो, वह असंभव ही लगता है।

items.summary_1line: It looks impossible until it is done.
items.summary_2to3line: The feeling of impossibility is not evidence. Most hard things only become believable after someone finishes them.
items.bodh_3to4line: Doubt is loudest before the first step. Break the impossible thing into a first move small enough to make today. Momentum rewrites what feels possible.

items.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
items.author: Steve Jobs

translations.en: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
translations.hi: महान कार्य करने का एकमात्र तरीका यह है कि आप अपने काम से प्रेम करें।

items.summary_1line: Love the work to make it great.
items.summary_2to3line: Sustained excellence is hard to fake. Genuine engagement with the craft is what carries you through the long middle.
items.bodh_3to4line: You cannot out-discipline indifference forever. If the work bores you, either find the part that fascinates you or change the work. Care is the raw material of quality.

items.text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
items.author: Attributed to Winston Churchill

translations.en: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
translations.hi: सफलता अंतिम नहीं और असफलता घातक नहीं; जो मायने रखता है वह आगे बढ़ने का साहस है।

items.summary_1line: Keep going - that is what counts.
items.summary_2to3line: Neither triumph nor defeat is the endpoint. The variable that matters most is the willingness to continue.
items.bodh_3to4line: Treat both success and failure as weather, not climate. Do not get attached to either. The habit of beginning again is the real asset.

items.text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
items.author: Arthur Ashe

translations.en: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
translations.hi: जहाँ हो वहीं से शुरू करो, जो है उसी से करो, जो कर सकते हो वही करो।

items.summary_1line: Begin with what you already have.
items.summary_2to3line: Perfect conditions are a fantasy. The work starts with the tools and time you actually possess right now.
items.bodh_3to4line: Waiting for ideal circumstances is a comfortable way to never start. Take inventory of what you have today and make the smallest real move with it. That is always enough to begin.

items.text: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
items.author: Attributed to Theodore Roosevelt

translations.en: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
translations.hi: मान लो कि तुम कर सकते हो, तो आधा रास्ता तय हो गया।

items.summary_2to3line: Confidence is not a guarantee of success, but its absence guarantees hesitation. Expectation shapes effort.
items.bodh_3to4line: Self-belief is not vanity; it is fuel. It changes how long you try and how well you recover. Feed it with evidence of your own past persistence.
